metadata.input: float64 samples x 2000 genes, log2(1+CPM), library sum computed over all 21745 genes; train-only variance selection
metadata.units: fractions of all detected nuclei in the adjacent Circle IF/RNAScope section, including unclassified Other nuclei in the denominator
metadata.target: Three independently measured HALO Circle-panel prop columns; never prop_sn or adjusted combined-panel prop

selection: Every retained test case; D02 returns consecutive disjoint100-sample output chunks while retaining full input sweep.
serialization: Lossless Python JSON float representation; nonfinite inputs to null.
protocol: Retained custom-protocol fallback; zero-shot, no labeled calibration or external fitting.
